Specification: This specification models a very small state machine over two integer-like variables x and y, both constrained initially to belong to the finite set S = {1,2,3}. It defines a helper action ITE(p, et, ee) that uses a TLA+ IF-THEN-ELSE expression as part of an action and also leaves y unchanged. The overall behavior is specified by Init and the temporal formula [][Next]_vars, where Next invokes the helper action with a condition comparing the current value of x to the next-state value of y, and either assigns x' = 2 or allows x' to be any element of S; no fairness or liveness properties beyond the safety-style specification are asserted.
IfThenElse: IF p THEN et ELSE ee
FunctionApplication: ITE( x = y', x' = 2, x' \in S )
